_note: Domain events and their subscriber scripts. Lifecycle wiring lives in .claude/settings.json; this file documents intent. Scripts read their payload via _hooklib.load_payload(), so both Claude Code (stdin) and a hand-set HOOK_PAYLOAD work. Every hook here ACTS or DENIES. Hooks whose only output was the name of a skill were deleted on 2026-08-04: hooks and skills are independent, a hook cannot invoke a skill, and a skill name written into hook source is an unvalidated second copy of a routing decision. Skills trigger from their own `description:` frontmatter.

session-start.description: At session start; loads the knowledge docs into context, then measures the repo against the branch point and renders the matching [state:<key>] block from workflow.md. Names no skill -- workflow.md owns what a state means.

user-prompt.description: Before a turn begins; classifies the prompt's entry shape -- work named with a settled approach, work named with an open one, or neither -- and renders the matching [state:<key>] block from workflow.md. Names no skill: it measures prompt shape, workflow.md's Entry table owns what that shape routes to. A hook cannot invoke a skill, so this raises the entry rule's visibility and does not guarantee a handoff.

post-run.description: After a turn completes; snapshots recovery state, commits the turn as a wip checkpoint if the artefact gates pass, then records the unit's state and says so when the chain stops advancing

pre-commit.description: Before a git commit/push finalizes; refuses credentials, protected-branch commits, and AI attribution in either the message or the target repo's configured author

pre-edit.description: Before a file write; refuses generated, vendored and lockfile targets

pre-deploy.description: Before a cloud-CLI command; allowlist-first free-tier spend guard

on-artifact-create.description: After a hook script is edited; demands it be fired against a real payload before being trusted

pre-run.description: Before any tool that changes state or spawns work; refuses while a halt is in force. Reads stay allowed on purpose, so a halt can be investigated

post-tool.description: After a shell tool returns; reports what its input just added to permanent session context. Reports only -- a PreToolUse hook must be able to block, and this one must not
